question.text: Why did France’s highest court rule against convicting Zhdanova for sexual exhibition?
options: The protest took place in private.
A conviction would unduly restrict her political expression.
The court found that she had not taken part in the protest.
quotes: convicting her for sexual exhibition in this case would disproportionately restrict her freedom of expression, given the protest’s political purpose.
convicting her in this case would disproportionately interfere with her freedom of expression because the act was political.
